svg.aria-label: KMS direct and envelope encryption flow
svg.text: Short values go through KMS directly; larger payloads use generated data keys and store encrypted key metadata.

g.text: Small token, credential, or configuration secret
Larger payload with local encryption and encrypted data-key metadata
Method context overrides default entries from KmsProperties.
Plaintext data keys are sensitive in-memory material; keep retention small.

svg.text: Decrypt succeeds only when the ciphertext, key choice, and encryption context match the original operation.
